_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:mcm_flick_translation/classicsprint.$CSR_Description: Makes sprinting work the way it did in the original Skyrim: hold the key to sprint instead of toggling it. Works with keyboards and controllers alike.
line:mcm_flick_translation/classicsprint.$CSR_ModActive_Tooltip: Turns the mod on and off. While it is off the game handles sprinting the way it does without the mod.
line:mcm_flick_translation/classicsprint.$ModConfigUI_Bind_ListeningTooltip: Press the button to bind, or Escape to cancel. Click again to give up.
line:mcm_flick_translation/classicsprint.$ModConfigUI_Bind_Tooltip: Click to bind a different button.
line:mcm_flick_translation/classicsprint.$ModConfigUI_RestoreDefaults_Confirm: This will reset every setting of this mod to its default value. This cannot be undone.
line:mcm_flick_translation/classicsprint.$ModConfigUI_RestoreDefaults_Tooltip: Resets every setting of this mod to its default value.
